Error.DbInitFailed:
ClipNest could not create or write to its database. This is commonly caused by security software (such as Windows Defender Controlled Folder Access) blocking writes, or insufficient folder permissions.

Please allow ClipNest in your security software, or set the CLIPNEST_HOME environment variable to a writable directory and restart.
